review: Hand-checked; approved with the Round 10 plan (Appendix C and the owner's cluster rule), 2026-10-01. Solar PV Installer and EV Service Technician are blue-collar (owner). Round 28 (owner): each is exactly two professions — the Round 10 pairs (Appendix C) — and the groups are gone.
rule: A combined career is exactly two of our professions (parentA, parentB). The server offers every one whose two professions are both anywhere in the student's ranked list; the report shows one only when BOTH are among the student's currently shown top 15 matches, so it follows their filters and sorts. Never generated per student; new ones come from the weekly scout after the owner approves them.

careers.name: EV Powertrain Engineer
careers.oneLiner: Designs the motors, batteries and drive systems that make electric vehicles move.
careers.howToGetThere: B.Tech in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering, then EV-focused projects or an M.Tech; EV makers hire from both sides.

careers.name: EV Service Technician
careers.oneLiner: Diagnoses and repairs electric two-wheelers, cars and their batteries.
careers.howToGetThere: ITI Electrician or Mechanic Motor Vehicle, then an EV service course (often given by the maker).

careers.name: Solar PV Installer & Technician
careers.oneLiner: Installs and maintains rooftop and field solar panels and their wiring.
careers.howToGetThere: ITI Electrician, then a solar PV installer course (NSQF / SCGJ aligned).

careers.name: BIM (Building Information Modelling) Specialist
careers.oneLiner: Builds the detailed 3D models that buildings are planned and built from.
careers.howToGetThere: Civil engineering, architecture or a CAD diploma, then Revit / BIM training.

careers.name: Medical Physicist
careers.oneLiner: Makes sure radiation used in scans and cancer treatment is safe and precise.
careers.howToGetThere: B.Sc and M.Sc Physics, then a one-year diploma in radiological / medical physics recognised by AERB.

careers.name: Semiconductor Process Engineer
careers.oneLiner: Runs and improves the chemical steps that turn silicon wafers into chips.
careers.howToGetThere: B.Tech in Chemical, Electronics or Materials, then fab training; India's new chip plants are hiring.

careers.name: Avionics & Aerospace Software Engineer
careers.oneLiner: Writes the safety-critical software that flies aircraft, drones and satellites.
careers.howToGetThere: B.Tech in CSE, ECE or Aerospace, then embedded and safety-critical software (DO-178C) experience.

careers.name: Regulatory Affairs Specialist (medical devices & pharma)
careers.oneLiner: Gets medical devices and medicines approved and keeps them within the rules.
careers.howToGetThere: A degree in pharmacy, biomedical engineering or life sciences, then a regulatory affairs certificate.

careers.name: Agricultural Drone Specialist
careers.oneLiner: Flies drones to survey, spray and monitor crops for farmers.
careers.howToGetThere: A DGCA Remote Pilot Certificate plus agriculture training; Krishi Vigyan Kendras and agri-drone firms train.

careers.name: Precision Agriculture Specialist
careers.oneLiner: Uses satellite maps, sensors and data to tell farmers exactly what each field needs.
careers.howToGetThere: B.Sc Agriculture plus GIS / remote sensing skills.

careers.name: Green Building Consultant
careers.oneLiner: Helps buildings use less energy and water, and certifies them (IGBC, GRIHA).
careers.howToGetThere: Architecture, civil engineering or environmental science, then an IGBC / GRIHA accreditation.

careers.name: Conservation Architect
careers.oneLiner: Restores and protects historic buildings without losing what made them special.
careers.howToGetThere: B.Arch, then a master's in architectural conservation.

careers.name: STEM & Robotics Educator
careers.oneLiner: Teaches children to build and program robots in schools and labs (e.g. Atal Tinkering Labs).
careers.howToGetThere: Any engineering or science degree plus hands-on robotics; many schools hire through ed-tech partners.

careers.name: Sports Journalist
careers.oneLiner: Reports, analyses and tells the stories of sport for papers, TV and digital media.
careers.howToGetThere: Any degree with journalism or mass communication training, and a portfolio of sports writing.

careers.name: Sports Nutritionist
careers.oneLiner: Plans what athletes eat to train, perform and recover.
careers.howToGetThere: B.Sc Nutrition & Dietetics, then a sports nutrition specialisation.

careers.name: Sports Physiotherapist
careers.oneLiner: Prevents and treats sports injuries and gets athletes back to play.
careers.howToGetThere: BPT, then an MPT in sports physiotherapy.

careers.name: Sports Data Analyst
careers.oneLiner: Turns match and training data into decisions for teams and coaches.
careers.howToGetThere: Statistics, data analytics or sports science, plus a portfolio of sports analysis.

careers.name: Sports Psychologist
careers.oneLiner: Helps athletes handle pressure, focus and confidence.
careers.howToGetThere: BA / B.Sc and MA / M.Sc Psychology, then sports psychology training.

careers.name: Sports Marketing & Management Professional
careers.oneLiner: Runs the business side of leagues, teams and sports brands.
careers.howToGetThere: Any degree, often a BBA / MBA in sports management, plus internships with leagues or agencies.

careers.name: Legal Journalist
careers.oneLiner: Explains court judgments and laws in plain words for the public.
careers.howToGetThere: LLB or journalism, ideally both; many start reporting for legal news sites.

careers.name: Cyber Law Specialist
careers.oneLiner: Handles the law around data, privacy, online fraud and cybercrime.
careers.howToGetThere: LLB, then a cyber law diploma or LLM; technical security knowledge helps.

careers.name: Forensic Accountant
careers.oneLiner: Traces fraud and hidden money for courts, companies and regulators.
careers.howToGetThere: CA or B.Com, then a forensic accounting certification (e.g. ICAI's FAFD).

careers.name: Environmental Lawyer
careers.oneLiner: Uses the law to protect forests, rivers and communities, often before the National Green Tribunal.
careers.howToGetThere: LLB, then environmental law practice or an LLM.

careers.name: Quantitative Analyst
careers.oneLiner: Builds mathematical models that price and manage risk in financial markets.
careers.howToGetThere: A degree in maths, statistics, engineering or economics, then programming and a master's or CFA / FRM.

careers.name: Climate Risk Analyst
careers.oneLiner: Measures how floods, heat and storms will hit property, crops and investments.
careers.howToGetThere: Atmospheric science, geography, statistics or actuarial training, plus climate-risk modelling.

careers.name: FinTech Product Manager
careers.oneLiner: Decides what a payments, lending or investing app should do next.
careers.howToGetThere: Any degree, a few years in product or banking, then the switch into fintech product.

careers.name: Data Journalist
careers.oneLiner: Finds the story in numbers and shows it with charts and maps.
careers.howToGetThere: Journalism plus data skills (spreadsheets, SQL, charts), or data analysis plus writing.

careers.name: Health Data & Informatics Specialist
careers.oneLiner: Makes hospital and public-health data useful — records, dashboards, disease tracking.
careers.howToGetThere: A health, statistics or computing degree, then health informatics training.

careers.name: Hospital Administrator
careers.oneLiner: Runs the beds, staff, budgets and quality of a hospital.
careers.howToGetThere: Any degree (health degrees help), then an MBA / MHA in hospital administration.

careers.name: Medical Writer
careers.oneLiner: Writes clinical study reports, drug documents and patient information.
careers.howToGetThere: A life-sciences or pharmacy degree plus strong writing; many start in pharma or CROs.

careers.name: Forensic Psychologist
careers.oneLiner: Applies psychology to crime, courts and prisons.
careers.howToGetThere: MA / M.Sc Psychology, then forensic psychology training; RCI registration for clinical work.

careers.name: Music Therapist
careers.oneLiner: Uses music to help people with stress, disability, dementia or recovery.
careers.howToGetThere: Musical training plus psychology, then a music therapy certificate or diploma.

careers.name: Art Therapist
careers.oneLiner: Uses drawing and making to help people express and work through difficult experiences.
careers.howToGetThere: An art or psychology background, then an art therapy diploma.

careers.name: Scientific & Medical Illustrator
careers.oneLiner: Draws the anatomy, cells and processes that textbooks and journals explain with.
careers.howToGetThere: Fine art or design plus biology, and a portfolio of scientific drawing.

careers.name: Science Communicator
careers.oneLiner: Explains science to the public through writing, video, museums and talks.
careers.howToGetThere: A science degree plus writing or media work; science museums and media hire.

careers.name: UX Researcher
careers.oneLiner: Studies how people use apps and products, so designers build the right thing.
careers.howToGetThere: Psychology, design or HCI, then user-research practice; a portfolio of studies.

careers.name: Technical Writer
careers.oneLiner: Writes the guides and documentation that explain software and machines.
careers.howToGetThere: Any degree with strong writing; tech background helps; a portfolio of docs.

careers.name: Game Audio Designer
careers.oneLiner: Creates the music, effects and voice that make a game feel alive.
careers.howToGetThere: Sound engineering or music production, then game-audio tools (Wwise, FMOD).

careers.name: Educational Game Designer
careers.oneLiner: Designs games that teach — for schools, apps and training.
careers.howToGetThere: Game design or instructional design, ideally both; a portfolio of learning games.

careers.name: Therapeutic & Clinical-Nutrition Chef
careers.oneLiner: Cooks for hospitals, wellness centres and special diets (diabetes, kidney, allergies).
careers.howToGetThere: A hotel-management or culinary course, then clinical-nutrition cooking training.

careers.name: Sustainable Fashion Specialist
careers.oneLiner: Makes clothing with less waste and fairer supply chains.
careers.howToGetThere: Fashion design or textiles, then sustainability and sourcing know-how.

careers.name: Wildlife Photographer & Filmmaker
careers.oneLiner: Photographs and films wildlife and nature for documentaries, magazines and conservation.
careers.howToGetThere: Photography or film training plus field knowledge of nature; most build a portfolio first.
